python3 - <<'PY'
import glob, hashlib, json, sys, tomllib, urllib.request
stack = [x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id'] == 'fastapi']
winners = sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers', []) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id') == 'fastapi'})
uvicorn_stack = [x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id'] == 'uvicorn']
uvicorn_winners = sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers', []) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id') == 'uvicorn'})
lock = tomllib.load(open('blueprints/convergence-practice/application-delivery/uv.lock', 'rb'))
pkgs = {p['name']: p for p in lock['package']}
rows = []
for name in ('fastapi', 'uvicorn'):
    p = pkgs[name]
    wheel = p['wheels'][0]
    want = wheel['hash'].removeprefix('sha256:')
    got = hashlib.sha256(urllib.request.urlopen(wheel['url'], timeout=30).read()).hexdigest()
    rows.append((name, p['version'], want, got))
ok = (stack == ['0.141.1'] and winners == ['0.141.1'] and rows[0][1] == '0.141.1' and rows[1][1] == '0.53.0'
      and all(want == got for _n, _v, want, got in rows))
print('FASTAPI_PINS_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| fastapi: manifests/stack.json', stack, 'landscape winner', winners, 'uv.lock', rows[0][1], '| uvicorn: uv.lock', rows[1][1], '(stack entries', uvicorn_stack, 'winner pins', uvicorn_winners, ') | locked wheel sha256 equals the downloaded wheel:', {n: want == got for n, _v, want, got in rows})
for name, version, want, got in rows:
    print(name, version, 'uv.lock sha256', want, 'downloaded', got)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY

D=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
SPID=
stop_server() {
  [ -n "$SPID" ] || return 0
  /bin/kill -TERM -- "-$SPID" 2>/dev/null
  n=0
  while [ "$n" -lt 50 ] && pgrep -g "$SPID" > /dev/null 2>&1; do n=$((n + 1)); sleep 0.1; done
  kill_needed=0
  if pgrep -g "$SPID" > /dev/null 2>&1; then kill_needed=1; /bin/kill -KILL -- "-$SPID" 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.2; fi
  if pgrep -g "$SPID" > /dev/null 2>&1; then left=1; else left=0; fi
  SPID=
}
trap 'stop_server; rm -rf "$D"' EXIT
cd blueprints/convergence-practice/application-delivery || exit 1
UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="$D/venv" timeout 300 uv sync --frozen --no-build > "$D/sync.log" 2>&1 || { echo "FASTAPI_SERVE_FAIL: uv sync --frozen --no-build failed"; tail -20 "$D/sync.log"; exit 1; }
versions=$("$D/venv/bin/python" -c "import importlib.metadata as m; print(m.version('fastapi'), m.version('uvicorn'))") || exit 1
PORT=$("$D/venv/bin/python" -c "import socket
s = socket.socket()
s.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
print(s.getsockname()[1])
s.close()") || exit 1
DATABASE_URL='postgresql://postgres@127.0.0.1:1/unused' PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 setsid "$D/venv/bin/python" -m uvicorn backend.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port "$PORT" > "$D/server.log" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
SPID=$!
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= -p "$SPID" | tr -d ' ')
[ "$PGID" = "$SPID" ] || { echo "FASTAPI_SERVE_FAIL: server pid $SPID is not its own process group leader (pgid $PGID)"; exit 1; }
i=0
ready=0
while [ "$i" -lt 90 ]; do
  if curl -fsS --max-time 3 -o "$D/schema.json" "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/openapi.json" 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 1
done
[ "$ready" = "1" ] || { echo "FASTAPI_SERVE_FAIL: server did not become ready"; tail -20 "$D/server.log"; exit 1; }
code_empty=$(curl -s --max-time 5 -o "$D/empty.json" -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/runs" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title": ""}')
code_extra=$(curl -s --max-time 5 -o "$D/extra.json" -w '%{http_code}' -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/runs" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"title": "ok", "admin": true}')
code_uuid=$(curl -s --max-time 5 -o "$D/uuid.json" -w '%{http_code}' -X PATCH "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/runs/not-a-uuid" -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"status": "passed", "expected_revision": 1}')
code_docs=$(curl -s --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/docs")
owned=$SPID
stop_server
if curl -fsS --max-time 1 -o /dev/null "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/openapi.json" 2>/dev/null; then port_open=1; else port_open=0; fi
python3 - "$D" "$code_empty" "$code_extra" "$code_uuid" "$code_docs" "$left" "$port_open" "$versions" "$owned" "$kill_needed" <<'PY'
import json, sys
d, ce, cx, cu, cd, left, port_open, versions, owned, kill_needed = sys.argv[1:11]
schema = json.load(open(d + '/schema.json'))
committed = json.load(open('openapi.json'))
empty = json.load(open(d + '/empty.json'))
extra = json.load(open(d + '/extra.json'))
badid = json.load(open(d + '/uuid.json'))
run_create = schema['components']['schemas']['RunCreate']
run_status = schema['components']['schemas']['RunStatus']
title_field = run_create['properties']['title']
checks = {
    'serving environment fastapi 0.141.1 uvicorn 0.53.0': versions.split() == ['0.141.1', '0.53.0'],
    'live /openapi.json == checked-in openapi.json': schema == committed,
    'RunCreate.title minLength 1 maxLength 120': title_field.get('minLength') == 1 and title_field.get('maxLength') == 120,
    'RunCreate forbids extra properties': run_create.get('additionalProperties') is False,
    'RunStatus enum matches app.py': run_status.get('enum') == ['planned', 'running', 'passed', 'failed'],
    'POST empty title -> 422': ce == '422',
    'POST extra field admin -> 422': cx == '422',
    'PATCH invalid uuid path -> 422': cu == '422',
    'GET /docs -> 200': cd == '200',
    'empty-title error names field title': any('title' in str(item.get('loc')) for item in empty.get('detail', [])),
    'extra-field error type extra_forbidden': any(item.get('type') == 'extra_forbidden' for item in extra.get('detail', [])),
    'invalid-uuid error type mentions uuid': any('uuid' in str(item.get('type', '')) for item in badid.get('detail', [])),
    'owned process group empty after signalling only it': left == '0',
    'port no longer accepts connections': port_open == '0',
}
failed = [k for k, v in checks.items() if not v]
print('FASTAPI_SERVE_' + ('OK' if not failed else 'FAIL'), '|', len(checks) - len(failed), 'of', len(checks), 'checks pass | env from uv sync --frozen --no-build: fastapi/uvicorn', versions, '| 422 codes', ce, cx, cu, '| /docs', cd, '| stopped only its own process group (setsid leader, pgid == pid ' + owned + '): processes left', left, '(KILL needed after TERM:', kill_needed + ') | failed:', failed)
for k, v in checks.items():
    print('PASS' if v else 'FAIL', '-', k)
raise SystemExit(0 if not failed else 1)
PY
